name: FIT-CORE OS - SaaS Gym Management Architecture
description: Enterprise All-in-One SaaS for fitness centers fusing FITCO, Virtuagym, and Glofox. Features interactive ERD/DBML schemas, NestJS Clean Architecture explorer, Redis distributed lock overbooking simulator, SUNAT/Culqi/Niubiz payment engine, IoT access control, boutique spot bookings, WOD/Bioimpedance tracker, and WhatsApp automation.
